newsitem.title: USA: Sheffield unit exercises clotrimazole option.
newsitem.headline: Sheffield unit exercises clotrimazole option.

text.p: Sheffield Medical Technologies Inc said its Ion Pharmaceuticals Inc unit exercised an option from Children's Medical Center Corp in Boston to license a series of patent rights relating to the use of certain compounds, including clotrimazole, in treating sickle cell anemia.
Terms of the license agreement were not disclosed. Officials from the company were not immediately available to comment.

Under the license, Ion has exclusive, worldwide rights to develop, commercialize and sublicense clotrimazole and other navel compounds owned by Ion and Children's in the treatment of sickle cell anemia, the company said.
Ion also said that under its sponsored research agreement with Children's, it will continue to fund the work of Dr. Varlo Brugnara, the project's principal investigator.
Ion said that Alpa Theraputic Corp, an affiliate of Green Cross Corp, holds an option from Ion to sublicense the technology for commercialization and development.
